description: Free to call. Runs the verification itself, consuming one credit. This is the step AFTER verify_agent: redeeming a payment grants a credit, and this spends it. Needs a FRESH challenge from get_verification_challenge — the signature used for verify_agent is already spent and reusing it fails with 'Signature already used'. Returns per-dimension results (ETV, SCV, WV, MCV, and WAV plus domain if the agent has proved domain ownership by DNS TXT record).

signed_message.description: The exact message that was signed.

title: Spend a credit and verify
